sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max. Qwen3.8-27B has vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and runs locally on 17GB RAM/VRAM setups. Qwen3.8 excels at agentic coding, vision and chat tasks, and can now run via Unsloth GGUFs, NVFP4 and Unsloth Desktop.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B: The Version You Can Actually Run, and How to Prepare For ...
sources.snippet: Qwen models tend to emit substantially more output tokens per task than peers. On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Qwen3.5-27B consumed roughly 98 million output tokens against about 56 million for MiniMax-M2.5 covering the same evaluation. That is close to a 1.75x multiplier on the side of the bill that costs most.
